portInfo.description: Sir Bani Yas Island is marketed by Visit Abu Dhabi as a wildlife and eco-adventure destination with safari, kayaking/diving, an ancient church site, resorts and stables. FAQs explicitly name Sir Bani Yas Cruise Beach, marine-protected areas and the Arabian Wildlife Park. Getting-there guidance covers hotel water taxi (Anantara guests), car to Jebel Dhanna Jetty plus free speedboat, bus to the island ferry terminal, private boats at Royal Bay Moorings, and private air taxi / island airstrip. No official LOA/depth table for alongside mega-ship berthing was published on the captured tourism page — treat most cruise calls as tender/beach landings unless the line states otherwise.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: From Abu Dhabi city Visit Abu Dhabi estimates 3–3.5 hours including the Jebel Dhanna drive and boat. Cruise guests usually tender from the ship’s anchorage — follow the line.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: All-terrain safari seats and sun exposure — hydrate and book via ship or official resorts.
